resolved_validation_issue.reason: The old test prohibited any companion-client mention in the full vipirc man page, while the canonical full manual intentionally documents both clients where relevant.
resolved_validation_issue.correction: Check the exact VIPIRC man header and release version; retain the standalone/minimalist product-isolation and exact manual-export assertions.

limitations: Full vipirc configure fails because wide-character curses development headers/library are unavailable. The vipirc -i binary uses actual main/core/manual code with aborting stubs for unavailable full UI entrypoints; it is not shipped.
The full Help-buffer regression exercises the real App storage and embedded manual with an in-memory transport fixture; it is not full curses rendering.

The vipirc install check executes only the real documentation/binary-copy recipes in a disposable tree with the clearly identified minimalist harness; it is not a full vipirc build/install certification.
Native named AF_UNIX lifecycle is restricted in this environment and was not retested for this documentation release.
No groff or mandoc executable is available; deterministic man source, ASCII, option coverage and roff block structure were checked, not formatter rendering.
No native OpenBSD/LibreSSL, live IRCNow, actual ZNC/soju daemon or long unattended soak is claimed.
This release does not repeat or relabel the historical security audit as a new security pass.
report_self_reference: These two generated report files omit their own byte digests. The final source manifest and archive checksum cover the completed reports.
